controls: Synthetic fixture transcript replay is classified as software transport, never real model inference.
Fixture output claiming inference execution and digital silence claiming inference are rejected.
Quality evidence requires explicit measured-inference class or a complete legacy report bound to profile ID, revision and profile digest.
Benchmark rankings reject software-transport evidence and preserve the 5% admission gate.
limitations: This is provenance and ranking guard evidence; it does not establish that any current local ASR model meets the 5% quality gate.
No clinical release or model promotion is authorized.
